test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

Looking at his watch Barin Babu observed that they were running more or less on time.

options.text: Looking at his watch Barin Babu said, “They had been running more or less on time.”
Looking at his watch Barin Babu said, “They were running more or less on time.”
Looking at his watch Barin Babu said, “We are running more or less on time.”
Looking at his watch Barin Babu said, “We have been running more or less on time.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The direct form of speech is generally structured with** quotation marks **and the exact words spoken by the speaker.
 
• When changing from** indirect to direct speech,** the** tense **of the** reported verb usually remains the same if the reporting verb is in the past.**

Hence, the correct statement is ''***Looking at his watch Barin Babu said, “We are running more or less on time.”*****

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direct speech** is used to quote the exact words spoken by someone, while indirect speech rephrases the speech without quotation marks.
 
• When converting **indirect speech** to direct speech, always remember to use the appropriate **punctuation** and changed pronouns **and **tenses** as needed to match the speaker's perspective.
